h:
我对另一个工作流程的小调整：

1.我提取了最后一个图像，以供我想扩展视频时使用。

2. 我保留了传入文件的文件名，并将该名称复制到视频、第一张图像和最后一张图像中。我通常将视频部分放在一起并使用 Davinci Resolve 对其进行升级。

3.我创建了一个新节点来保留我的提示。我倾向于重复使用提示，并且想要一种使用开/关开关来组合它们的方法。或者更确切地说，两个提示同时出现。一种带有提示，另一种带有开关。这是我第一次尝试提示。

4.我把平时换的东西放在一个单独的盒子里放在上面。我很少在下面进行更改。我从不使用 T2V，因为我从来没有从中得到任何好的结果，而且我只是坚持使用 Clownshark 采样器，因为我认为它是最好的。我现在不记得为什么了。

您将需要额外的节点，该节点位于此处的文章中：“又一个工作流程 v0.39”的衍生产品、新节点和提示 |奇维泰

o.en:
My small adjustments from Yet another workflow:

1. I extracted the last image, for when I want to extend the video.

2. I kept the filename from the incoming file and copied this name to the video, the first image, and the last image. I usually put the video parts together and upscale them using Davinci Resolve.

3. I made a new node to keep my prompts. I tend to reuse prompts, and wanted a way to combine them using on/off switches. Or rather, two prompts that go together. One with the prompts and one with the on/off switches. This is my first attempt at a prompt.

4. I put the things that I usually change in a box of their own on top. I rarely make changes below. I never use T2V, since I have never gotten any good results from that, and I just got stuck with the Clownshark sampler since I imagined that it was the best one. I can't remember why now.

You will need the extra node, which is in the article here:A spinoff on "Yet another workflow v0.39", a new node, and a prompt revelation | Civitai
